### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Report patient-stated symptoms and their characteristics (e.g., onset, duration, severity, associated symptoms, impact on activities) precisely as described. Do not infer exacerbating factors or triggers unless explicitly stated by the patient.
[A/P-Section]: Differentiate between actions that have already occurred and those that are planned for the future. Report only completed actions as such; describe future actions using future tense or as recommendations/orders.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Strictly attribute physical exam findings to the specific body system (e.g., cardiovascular, respiratory) as explicitly stated by the provider. Do not transfer findings between systems or infer unstated findings for a given system.
